design_description: A fierce black design for Leones FC, featuring a large, subtle tone-on-tone roaring lion across the torso and back. Dynamic red diagonal slashes add aggression and movement, while an asymmetrical vertical red-and-gold stripe highlights the crest. Gold numbering, red-and-gold collar and sleeve trims, and matching striped shorts complete a powerful, bold look inspired by the strength and pride of a lion.
